verdict.rationale: Selective subscription is a fair axis for a real-time video platform, but the evidence pack never documents subscribing to only one track (audio-only or video-only) of a stream while the publisher stays unchanged. The pack covers subscriber delivery over a single peer connection and Media Router features, which are adjacent and not single-track subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
